_comment_detection: === DETECTION PARAMETERS === Controls how birds are identified in each frame

detection._comment_min_contour_area: Minimum pixel area for a detection. SMALLER = detect smaller/farther birds but more noise. LARGER = only bigger birds, fewer false positives. Range: 1-50
detection._comment_max_contour_area: Maximum pixel area - filters out large objects. SMALLER = stricter. LARGER = allows bigger detections. Range: 100-1000
detection._comment_mog2_history: Frames for background model. SMALLER = adapts faster. LARGER = more stable. Range: 100-1000
detection._comment_mog2_var_threshold: Background subtraction sensitivity. SMALLER = more sensitive, more detections. LARGER = less sensitive. Range: 8-50
detection._comment_blur_kernel_size: Gaussian blur (must be odd). SMALLER = sharper, more noise. LARGER = smoother, may blur small birds. Range: 1-9
detection._comment_morph_kernel_size: Morphology kernel. SMALLER = keeps small detections. LARGER = removes noise but may erase small birds. Range: 1-5
detection._comment_morph_iterations: Morphology passes. SMALLER = less filtering. LARGER = more aggressive. Range: 1-3
detection._comment_clahe_enabled: Contrast enhancement for dark birds against bright sky
detection._comment_clahe_clip_limit: Contrast limit. SMALLER = subtle. LARGER = stronger but may amplify noise. Range: 1.0-4.0
detection._comment_clahe_tile_size: Tile grid size. SMALLER = more local contrast. LARGER = more uniform. Range: 4-16
detection._comment_motion_diff_threshold: Frame differencing threshold. SMALLER = detects slow/gliding birds. LARGER = only fast movement, may miss slow birds. Range: 5-40

_comment_tracking: === TRACKING PARAMETERS === Links detections across frames

tracking._comment_max_disappeared: Frames before losing track. SMALLER = IDs change often. LARGER = maintains ID during occlusion. Range: 10-60
tracking._comment_max_distance: Max pixels to associate between frames. SMALLER = stricter. LARGER = allows fast birds. Range: 30-150

_comment_spatial_filter: === SPATIAL FILTER === Removes detections below horizon (ground clutter)

spatial_filter._comment_enabled: true = filter ground area, false = detect everywhere
spatial_filter._comment_horizon_line_percent: Where horizon is (0.0=top, 1.0=bottom). SMALLER = more sky. LARGER = stricter. Range: 0.5-0.95

_comment_temporal_filter: === TEMPORAL FILTER === Requires consistent detection to confirm (reduces false positives)

temporal_filter._comment_enabled: true = stricter, fewer false positives. false = immediate detection
temporal_filter._comment_min_confirm_frames: Frames to confirm detection. SMALLER = faster. LARGER = stricter. Range: 3-20
temporal_filter._comment_min_move_distance: Min pixels movement to confirm. SMALLER = confirms stationary. LARGER = requires movement. Range: 10-100

_comment_exclusion_zones: === EXCLUSION ZONES === Manual areas to ignore (lamp posts)

exclusion_zones._comment_enabled: true = mask specified areas, false = detect everywhere
exclusion_zones._comment_zones: Rectangles {x, y, width, height} in pixels from top-left
exclusion_zones._comment_draw_debug: Draw zones on output for debugging

_comment_nms: === NON-MAXIMUM SUPPRESSION === Benchmark: +3.8% accuracy (+25 birds), -2.6% overhead (FASTER!). HIGHLY EFFECTIVE - KEEP ENABLED

nms._comment_enabled: ✅ ENABLED per benchmark: Reduces lamp post clusters, improves bird detection accuracy with minimal cost
nms._comment_grid_size: Cell size in pixels. SMALLER = finer grid, better for tiny birds (1-15px). LARGER = coarser, faster. Range: 16-64
nms._comment_max_per_cell: Max boxes per cell before NMS kicks in. SMALLER = stricter (filters more). LARGER = allows denser flocks. Range: 2-8
nms._comment_iou_threshold: Overlap threshold for merging. SMALLER = more aggressive merging. LARGER = only merge highly overlapping boxes. Range: 0.2-0.5
